department: Doctoral Program in Molecular Life Sciences (EDMS)

deadline.value: Deadlines November 1 and March 31 (March 31 is new from 2027). Next for Fall 2027: November 1, 2026 (year inferred).
deadline.quote: validated online before March 31st (new deadline as of 2027) or November 1st, respectively, at the latest.

gre_general.value: TOEFL and/or GRE results are recommended for non-native English speakers.
gre_general.quote: We recommend that applicants whose first language is not English provide us with the results of the TOEFL and/or GRE test.

supervisor.value: You are enrolled only if accepted by EDMS and hired by a thesis director at the Hiring Days.
supervisor.quote: Only if they are accepted by EDMS and hired by a thesis director, they will be enrolled in the program.

funding.value: Enrolment requires secure funding, so admitted students are funded (typically as salaried EPFL doctoral assistants).
funding.quote: The final enrollment in the doctoral program is conditional to the choice of a thesis topic, a supervisor and a secure funding.

also.quote: The basic starting salary of an EPFL doctoral assistant is CHF 55’225.- gross per annum

entry_route.value: Typically a master's; 4- or 5-year bachelor's holders may apply with enough math and physics.
entry_route.quote: Typically, the prerequisite is a Master’s degree (M.Sc.) in the relevant discipline.

gre_subject.value: The program page does not mention a GRE Subject test.

notes: Interviews at Hiring Days in January and June; travel and accommodation reimbursed.
